rationale: Although SA displays strong downward momentum on 12.54x relative volume and is breaking to new session lows at $20.31, the bid-ask spread is excessively wide at 49.2 bps ($0.10). Additionally, price is already heavily extended below the 9-EMA ($21.52) and session VWAP ($21.37) by nearly three 5-minute ATRs after five consecutive bearish 1-minute candles. Shorting at the absolute low of a stretched move with high spread friction offers poor risk-reward, while longing lacks any structural support or reversal confirmation.
